paddock.title: mullet-paddock
paddock.blurb: The operator's web UI and the gateway that turns its buttons into ROS 2 actions and service calls. It never talks to PX4.
paddock.wires: Finds drones from /mullet/heartbeat and frameworks from /mullet/mission_status, then calls the names those messages advertise.

interfaces.title: mullet-interfaces
interfaces.blurb: The messages, services and actions every other repository builds against. It contains no running code.
interfaces.wires: Built into the supervisor, Paddock's gateway, the simulator and every framework.

ergodic.title: ergodic_mppi
ergodic.blurb: Flies a drone so its time over an area matches a density the operator draws. MPPI on the Orin's GPU at 50 Hz.
ergodic.wires: Paddock loads a spec with LoadMission; the framework streams MissionCommand to the supervisor while it is in MISSION.

core.title: mullet-core
core.blurb: The drone's state machine: IDLE, TRANSITION, HOLD and MISSION. The only node that sends setpoints to PX4.
core.wires: Publishes the heartbeat at 10 Hz, serves takeoff, land, return home, start mission and hold, and forwards MissionCommand in MISSION.

localization.title: mullet-localization
localization.blurb: One drone's localization: pins the driver and estimator images, holds the calibration, and records bags.
localization.wires: Its px4_ev_bridge sends the estimate to EKF2 as external vision, or only records it in shadow mode.

px4.title: PX4
px4.blurb: PX4 v1.17.0 on a Pixhawk 6C: attitude control, motor output, the EKF2 estimator and the failsafes.
px4.wires: Reaches ROS 2 through the Micro XRCE-DDS Agent on the Orin, over serial. Parameters and profiles come from mullet-px4.

vio.title: mullet-vio
vio.blurb: Visual-inertial odometry images. OpenVINS today, on the D435i's infrared stereo and IMU.
vio.wires: Publishes nav_msgs/Odometry for the bridge in mullet-localization.

lio.title: mullet-lio
lio.blurb: LiDAR-inertial odometry images. A scaffold: no implementation has been chosen yet.
lio.wires: Will read the MID-360's point cloud and IMU, and publish odometry for the bridge.

drivers.title: mullet-drivers
drivers.blurb: Driver images for the RealSense D435i and the Livox MID-360, and an optional RViz and Foxglove image.
drivers.wires: Publishes camera, LiDAR and IMU topics for the estimators.

base.title: mullet-base
base.blurb: ROS 2 Jazzy for the Orin, with CUDA 13.2, px4_msgs 1.17 and the Micro XRCE-DDS Agent.
base.wires: Every drone image starts FROM ghcr.io/skymule-ai/mullet-base:v0.5.1.

sim.title: mullet-sim
sim.blurb: A fleet of simulated PX4 drones with Gazebo, each with its own supervisor.
sim.wires: Paddock's development backend and the test target for frameworks, on ROS 2 domain 42.
